items.claim: CFO reiterates 2026 revenue guidance floor.
items.quote: We expect revenue of at least $3.75 billion
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO raises full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance range by $5M on each end.
items.quote: EBITDA guidance of $650 million to $665 million
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO states updated non-GAAP EPS guidance range.
items.quote: non-GAAP earnings per share guidance of $4.60 to $4.75
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO states full-year free cash flow guidance range.
items.quote: We expect free cash flow of $315 million to $330 million
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO raises Government Operations margin expectation for the year.
items.quote: government operations margins to exceed 19% for the year
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO states Commercial Operations segment adjusted EBITDA margin for the quarter.
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margin in the quarter was 12.9%
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO gives a ceiling estimate for CapEx as a percent of sales if it exceeds the 6% plan.
items.quote: somewhere around the 7%-ish range
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CEO states BWXT's current position as sole scaled TRISO fuel producer.
items.quote: we are the only producer of TRISO at any scale at this point
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CFO frames U.S. localized manufacturing as a competitive edge versus non-U.S. suppliers.
items.quote: localized in the U.S. creates a competitive advantage
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CFO discloses the approximate purchase price paid for the PCG acquisition.
items.quote: it was roughly around $200 million
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CEO states balance sheet capacity to fund needed capacity expansion.
items.quote: we have got the balance sheet to do what we need to do
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CFO flags possible upside to CapEx above the planned ~6% of sales level.
items.quote: CapEx may exceed that level in future periods
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

items.claim: CEO states current annual TRISO fuel production volume.
items.quote: We're producing hundreds of kilograms a year
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO gives forward growth expectation for the Medical segment.
items.quote: we're forecasting high teens growth this year
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO characterizes nuclear project delivery risk as an existential industry risk.
items.quote: that is an existential and important risk
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO cites historical nuclear project delivery failures as a cautionary example.
items.quote: some poor examples of project delivery Vogtle and others
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO confirms BWXT is a Golden Dome missile defense program contract recipient.
items.quote: We are a Golden Dome contract recipient awardee
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO highlights Kinectrics being selected for a U.K. tritium fuel cycle facility.
items.quote: Kinectrics being selected as the design and fabrication
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CEO commits to fulfilling existing Navy/government contract obligations at PCG despite the commercial pivot.
items.quote: We're under contract to deliver. We will absolutely deliver
items.speaker: Rex Geveden (CEO)

items.claim: CFO describes PCG's manufacturing scope as limited to certain component types, not full large-component capability.
items.quote: primarily focused on manufacturing of certain aspects
items.speaker: Michael Fitzgerald (CFO)

qa_flags.question: William Blair analyst asks what could help solve/de-risk balance-of-plant and nuclear-island EPC delivery, pressing for how government could step in.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO twice restates/reframes the question back to the analyst ('Again, you're talking about delivery risk for the balance of plant in the nuclear island, Jed.') rather than answering directly; analyst has to re-ask before getting a general, non-specific answer that EPC delivery is 'a problem the Bechtels and Fluors of the world are going to have to solve.'

qa_flags.question: Deutsche Bank analyst asks whether Kinectrics has direct exposure to high-voltage data center build-out.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO admits lack of specific knowledge ('I don't know the details on that. I suspect that we do.') rather than confirming with a concrete answer.
